_comment: Model choice is configuration, never code. Override provider with env QA_MODEL_PROVIDER. No automatic fallback between providers.

grok._comment: xAI Chat Completions (OpenAI-compatible) POST {base_url}/chat/completions with response_format json_schema strict. Disabled until Milestone B2 approval. Prices MUST be entered from the xAI console/models page (USD per 1M tokens); null => refuses to run.
grok._egress_comment: Approved external model hosts live in config/policy.json tools.model.request.approved_hosts (separate from this base_url). Non-loopback endpoints must use https.

issue_tracker._comment: provider: mock_jira (default, synthetic fixtures) | jira_cloud | jira_dc. Real providers need integrations.<name> enabled+approved+credentials+https allowlisted host.

budget._comment: PROPOSED caps for the B2 live eval (not an approved authorization). total_usd is persisted per scope across runs and days; the xAI Console spend limit is a separate provider-side prerequisite.

auth._comment: demo = unauthenticated approver label (local demo only). local = hashed bearer tokens from users_file with roles viewer/requester/approver. Neither is SSO.

unattended_eval_approval._comment: Synthetic-eval harness only. Requires a server-side eval grant created by an authenticated approver (POST /api/eval-grants or python -m qa_agent.eval_authorization create). Normal approvals are unaffected.

git._comment: provider: synthetic_git (default, fixtures/repos) | bitbucket_cloud | bitbucket_dc (read-only REST, never clones).

integrations._comment: ALL DISABLED. Fill in only after Bluemeteor grants read-only service accounts. Credentials are env var NAMES, never values.

jira_cloud._comment: Jira Cloud REST v3 (https://<site>.atlassian.net). auth basic = account email + API token.

jira_dc._comment: Jira Data Center REST v2. auth bearer = personal access token.

bitbucket_cloud._comment: Bitbucket Cloud REST 2.0 (https://api.bitbucket.org/). repositories: WORKSPACE/slug. auth bearer = repository/workspace access token (read scopes).

bitbucket_dc._comment: Bitbucket Data Center REST 1.0. repositories: PROJECT/slug. auth bearer = HTTP access token (repo read). Code search unsupported.

projects._comment: Workspace project selection. Each project binds a tracker project key, repositories and environments.
